snapshot.text: Mainly public, tax-funded system that has expanded fast: 743 health units built in eight years. The ministry is recruiting thousands of health workers, building hospitals and introducing a malaria vaccine.

priorities.title: Recruiting health workers
priorities.text: 6,000 more health professionals to be recruited, with public exams opening in July 2026.

priorities.title: Emergency operations centres
priorities.text: A national network of public health emergency operations centres was inaugurated.

priorities.title: Primary care with the World Bank
priorities.text: Angola and the World Bank are strengthening their partnership on primary health care.
